description: This file contains helper functions for creating and setting up a large number of git packs, including functions to generate packs with blobs and configure git settings to disable automatic garbage collection and repacking.

methods.name: create_packs
methods.description: Creates a specified number of packs, each containing a single blob, by generating data using Perl and importing it into git.

methods.name: setup_many_packs
methods.description: Sets up git configuration to disable automatic garbage collection and pack auto-limiting, then creates a large number (500) of packs.
